conventions.convention: The multiplicative normalization is (T_i−Q)(T_i+1)=0 and T_iX_iT_i=QX_{i+1}; all coefficient parameters are units, and the cyclotomic polynomial is imposed on X₁ only.
The rank-one lemma works over a field with nonzero parameters. Its nonzero-nilpotent conclusion assumes r≥2 and all cyclotomic parameters equal the same nonzero c.
A box (c,a,b) has multiplicative content u_c Q^(b−a), with generic field Q(Q,u₁,…,u_r).
The finite type-A parameter v is specialized directly to Q in the normalization (T_i−v)(T_i+1)=0.

load_bearing.statement: For R=Z[Q^{±1},u₁^{±1},…,u_r^{±1}], the elements X₁^{a₁}⋯X_n^{a_n}T_w with 0≤a_i<r and w∈S_n form an R-basis of H_{r,n}. After every commutative R-algebra base change S, their images remain an S-basis; no flatness or semisimplicity of S is required.

Let F be a field and q,u₁,…,u_r∈F×. The rank-one specialization is isomorphic to F[X]/(∏_{a=1}^r(X−u_a)), with F-basis 1,X,…,X^{r−1}. If r≥2 and u₁=⋯=u_r=c≠0, ε=X−c identifies it with F[ε]/(ε^r), and ε is a nonzero nilpotent.

concerns.concern: The Verification's Given says “The rank-two, one-box content sequences”, although the Example and calculation have level r=2 and rank n=1. This confuses level with rank; the calculation itself uses the correct parameters.

alerts.finding: Step 1.3 states “z^csz^dsY=az^{c+d}Y+z^{c+1}sz^d”, with Y=szs. This identity is false as printed. Set r=2, Q=1, u₁=1, u₂=−1, v=w=1, and use the scalar representation X₁=X₂=1, T₁=s=−1 over Q. All stated relations hold, a=0 and z=Y=1. At c=d=0 the displayed identity reads 1=−1. The cited Neaime source, Lemma 6.2 Case 2 (PDF p.33, https://arxiv.org/pdf/1810.12053), treats the corresponding product without that extra s. This is a local proof-expression defect in the published supplier.

The second prose paragraph says it “derives the $A$-basis $\{X^\lambda T_w\}$”. Its theorem thm-hh-affine-type-a-bernstein-pbw instead states that this is an R₀-basis, where A=R₀[X₁^{±1},…,X_n^{±1}]. The displayed family is A-linearly dependent: its elements 1 and X₁ satisfy X₁·1−1·X₁=0. The theorem and its proof correctly give the A-basis (T_w); the page summary mislabels the coefficient ring.

seams_checked.note: Compared the affine presentation and PBW statement with the cyclotomic presentation, transport lemma, and page formulas. Quadratic normalization, compact affine relation, Bernstein sign, and coefficient extension agree. Rank one is handled directly, outside the affine supplier's n≥2 domain. The affine page's separate basis-label defect is recorded in alerts.

Checked the Murphy page, its defining elements, and the cellularity theorem against the cyclotomic suppliers. The uses preserve L_i=X_i, the relation on L₁ only, the universal coefficient ring, PBW rank r^n n!, colored tableau count, and arbitrary commutative base change.
